# DSH 会话字号控制 > 为 DSH 会话字号添加输入栏步进器、快捷键和 Ctrl 滚轮。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale) - **版本号**：0.1.1（[固定提交 8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/tree/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的字号写入宿主、按键范围与滚轮拦截。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：反复调会话字号的人可直接使用输入栏控件。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 新增输入栏、按键和滚轮操作面。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 全局滚轮截获不等同于全页缩放。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 验证限定滚轮作用域。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 先测试按钮和已有浏览器缩放习惯。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 新增输入栏、按键和滚轮操作面。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 全局滚轮截获不等同于全页缩放。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 验证限定滚轮作用域。 用鼠标与触控板分别对照 ## 场景与替代办法 反复调会话字号的人可直接使用输入栏控件。 原生设置可调字号，但需进入设置页。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH Web 及主题服务 | 必需 | 挂载并写字号 | 使用原设置 | | 快捷键服务 | 按键需要 | 注册动作 | 用按钮 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 启用 | 核对原生读数 | 看是否同步 | | 调整 | 测快捷键与滚轮 | 验证缩放边界 | | 退出 | 移除插件 | 必要时重置宿主字号 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源未知 | 安装耗时未知 | 支持角色 API | | 持续 | 运行开销未知 | 操作耗时未知 | 主题写入 | | 恢复 | 恢复开销未知 | 排查耗时未知 | 可使用原设置 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 会话字号 | 多入口写同一角色 | 真实兼容和无障碍体验 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：字号写入宿主、按键范围与滚轮拦截 ### Q01 · 已有字号设置时为什么还需要？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 它把控制放进输入栏，减少离开会话打开设置的操作。源码仍向同一个 theme 服务写 text 角色，与宿主设置共享当前值；增量在控制位置和快捷方式。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:10-35](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/README.md#L10-L35) 已有设置、按钮和替代
查看原文（26行） ```text ## Why this exists DSH already ships a conversation font-size setting — **Settings → General → 字号大小 / Font size**, contributed by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`. Its copy is explicit that it *"only affects conversation content"*, which is exactly the right scope. This plugin does not replace or reimplement it. It adds the input surfaces that setting lacks: - reaching it takes four clicks, so it is easy to forget it exists; - there is no keyboard shortcut for it anywhere in the shipped shortcuts registry; - there is no wheel gesture for it. Every control here writes through the **same** `theme.setFontSize('text', px)` entry point the shipped row uses, so the two can never disagree. ## What it does | Surface | Where | Behaviour | |---|---|---| | Stepper | composer tool row, before the submit action | `A−` / readout / `A+`, clamping at the ends | | Reset | beside the stepper | `↺` restores the default; greys out when already there | | Shortcuts | `Ctrl`+`=` / `Ctrl`+`-` / `Ctrl`+`0` | increase / decrease / restore default | | Zoom | `Ctrl`+wheel over the page | wheel up enlarges, wheel down shrinks | Both the readout and the reset button render the **live** size from the theme snapshot, so a change made in the shipped settings row updates this control immediately, and vice versa. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:119-132](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L119-L132) 读取与写入宿主字号
查看原文（14行） ```text const ROLE = 'text' const current = () => themeOf()?.getTheme().fontSizes?.[ROLE] ?? DEFAULT const write = (px) => { const theme = themeOf() if (theme === undefined) return const next = clamp(px) if (next === current()) return // `setFontSize(role, px)`, not `setFontSize(px)`: a bare number is read as the // role, and the service then throws while formatting its own error message // (`spec.min` on an undefined spec), so every click died before writing. theme.setFontSize(ROLE, next) } const step = (delta) => write(current() + delta) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:247-257](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L247-L257) 注册输入栏插槽
查看原文（11行） ```text ctx.slots.inject('conversation.input.right', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: 'conversation.input.right', id: NS, order: 20, }, Control)) } return { inject: ['slots'], apply, } ```
#### 缺口 - 未测实际节时 **影响**：不知道使用频率 **进一步探讨**：比较一次调节的步骤 ### Q02 · 按钮、快捷键和滚轮如何同步？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 控制从同一主题快照读数，写入会先 clamp 并略过未变化值。快捷键经宿主注册，滚轮在非被动监听中按间隔步进，释放 effect 时移除监听。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:119-132](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L119-L132) 同步入口
查看原文（14行） ```text const ROLE = 'text' const current = () => themeOf()?.getTheme().fontSizes?.[ROLE] ?? DEFAULT const write = (px) => { const theme = themeOf() if (theme === undefined) return const next = clamp(px) if (next === current()) return // `setFontSize(role, px)`, not `setFontSize(px)`: a bare number is read as the // role, and the service then throws while formatting its own error message // (`spec.min` on an undefined spec), so every click died before writing. theme.setFontSize(ROLE, next) } const step = (delta) => write(current() + delta) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:155-169](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L155-L169) 滚轮与解绑
查看原文（15行） ```text // Ctrl+wheel. preventDefault suppresses the shell's own page zoom so the // gesture means one thing only. let lastWheel = 0 ctx.effect(() => { const onWheel = (event) => { if (!event.ctrlKey || event.deltaY === 0) return event.preventDefault() const now = Date.now() if (now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS) return lastWheel = now step(event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1) } window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false }) return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel) }, `${NS}: ctrl+wheel`) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:179-202](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L179-L202) 快捷键注册
查看原文（24行） ```text const registerShortcuts = (scope) => { const shortcuts = scope.shortcuts ?? ctx.get('shortcuts') if (shortcuts === undefined) return for (const command of commands) { scope.effect(() => shortcuts.register({ id: command.id, label: command.label, aliases: ['font size', command.alias], defaults: { 'desktop:macos': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] }, 'desktop:windows': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] }, 'desktop:linux': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] }, 'web:macos': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] }, 'web:windows': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] }, }, // "editable" keeps the bindings alive while the composer has focus. regions: ['page', 'editable'], modals: [], resolve: () => ({ status: 'handled', run: command.run }), }), `${NS}: ${command.id}`) } } if (typeof ctx.inject === 'function') ctx.inject(['shortcuts'], registerShortcuts) else registerShortcuts(ctx) ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行不同宿主 **影响**：按键冲突未知 **进一步探讨**：测试按键和默认设置互改 ### Q03 · 对全页缩放有什么影响？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 滚轮处理在检查冷却及是否实际写入前调用 preventDefault。因此 Ctrl 滚轮即使处于字号上限或 theme 尚未就绪，也可能被吞掉。插件只写 text，不替代终端、代码和页面整体缩放。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:119-131](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L119-L131) 只写 text 角色
查看原文（13行） ```text const ROLE = 'text' const current = () => themeOf()?.getTheme().fontSizes?.[ROLE] ?? DEFAULT const write = (px) => { const theme = themeOf() if (theme === undefined) return const next = clamp(px) if (next === current()) return // `setFontSize(role, px)`, not `setFontSize(px)`: a bare number is read as the // role, and the service then throws while formatting its own error message // (`spec.min` on an undefined spec), so every click died before writing. theme.setFontSize(ROLE, next) } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:155-169](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L155-L169) 先阻止默认动作
查看原文（15行） ```text // Ctrl+wheel. preventDefault suppresses the shell's own page zoom so the // gesture means one thing only. let lastWheel = 0 ctx.effect(() => { const onWheel = (event) => { if (!event.ctrlKey || event.deltaY === 0) return event.preventDefault() const now = Date.now() if (now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS) return lastWheel = now step(event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1) } window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false }) return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel) }, `${NS}: ctrl+wheel`) ```
#### 缺口 - 未测不同浏览器缩放 **影响**：不能判断无障碍体验 **进一步探讨**：在字号边界对照浏览器手势 ### Q04 · 怎样试用并退出？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 用有角色字号 API 的 DSH Web profile，核对按钮、快捷键和原设置读数。若需要保留浏览器 Ctrl 滚轮语义，移除包并使用原生设置。代码有解绑，字号最终值是否保留按宿主设置核对。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:37-57](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/README.md#L37-L57) 版本和卸载
查看原文（21行） ````text ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (the `desktop` profile, or any profile mounting `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`). - A theme service that exposes `setFontSize(role, px)` — i.e. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`, which ships in the default composition. **DSH 0.2.1 or newer**: that release split the single font size into the `text` / `code` / `terminal` roles, and this plugin drives `text`. - No build step and no runtime dependencies beyond the browser module table. ## Install This package is a **dsh bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so dsh treats [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a composition layer and mounts it for you. ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-client-ui-font-scale ``` That installs the package into the profile and appends it to the profile's bundle list. The profile is watched, so dsh recomposes without a restart. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-client-ui-font-scale`. ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:148-169](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L148-L169) 样式与事件清理
查看原文（22行） ```text ctx.effect(() => { const el = document.createElement('style') el.textContent = CSS document.head.appendChild(el) return () => el.remove() }, `${NS}: styles`) // Ctrl+wheel. preventDefault suppresses the shell's own page zoom so the // gesture means one thing only. let lastWheel = 0 ctx.effect(() => { const onWheel = (event) => { if (!event.ctrlKey || event.deltaY === 0) return event.preventDefault() const now = Date.now() if (now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS) return lastWheel = now step(event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1) } window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false }) return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel) }, `${NS}: ctrl+wheel`) ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行安装卸载 **影响**：持久状态及冲突未知 **进一步探讨**：在测试 profile 先改回默认再移除 ### Q05 · 仅输入栏范围截获会更合适吗？ **研究主题**：新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 比较当前窗口级监听与限定会话区域的方案，记录调字成功率及浏览器缩放误触。如果限定区域使用户常常无法调整而误触下降很少，就保持现有行为。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/client.js:155-169](https://github.com/AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale/blob/8b2d199906f400a0e6403b21c743b0f5ce577f4a/lib/client.js#L155-L169) 窗口级滚轮
查看原文（15行） ```text // Ctrl+wheel. preventDefault suppresses the shell's own page zoom so the // gesture means one thing only. let lastWheel = 0 ctx.effect(() => { const onWheel = (event) => { if (!event.ctrlKey || event.deltaY === 0) return event.preventDefault() const now = Date.now() if (now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS) return lastWheel = now step(event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1) } window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false }) return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel) }, `${NS}: ctrl+wheel`) ```
#### 缺口 - 无用户操作样本 **影响**：价值未知 **进一步探讨**：用鼠标与触控板分别对照 ## 工程统计 统计范围：git tracked files at exact commit; component scope only；组件：根；内容摘要：035adab8b7665f0b4ec17dbe397c15b3012b33048e7c3607e6c62758ec6d0492。sloc 0.3.2，TypeScript 5.9.3。 仅统计 Markdown 和指定的 JavaScript／TypeScript 扩展名；Python 等其他语言不纳入，表格不代表全语言代码规模。 | 扩展名 | 范围 | 文件数 | 总行 | 代码行 | 注释行 | 字数 | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | .js | source | 2 | 268 | 175 | 77 | — | | .md | source | 1 | 195 | — | — | 1291 | | .mjs | source | 1 | 157 | 113 | 30 | — | 排除 0 项，解析错误 0 项；默认排除规则是启发式，源文件与打包产物可能重复，不能从行数推算原创量或工时。Markdown 字数与代码行分别计量，未知不填0。 ## 能力清单 | 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 | | --- | --- | --- | | 字号 | 调整会话文字 | 依赖主题服务 | | 滚轮 | 加速调节 | 会覆盖对应全页手势 | ## 工程亮点 字号存储复用宿主，监听在 effect 退场。 ## 验证与边界 - 已检查：作者 README、包清单、源码路径 README.md、lib/client.js 及固定范围 inventory；组件：仓库根。抽读不冒充完整审计，来源和原文嵌入正式快照时保留。 - 未执行：插件安装、目标代码与测试、真实宿主及模型任务。源码存在不等于运行通过。 - 边界：静态核查固定提交的字号写入宿主、按键范围与滚轮拦截。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 - 下一步：用鼠标与触控板分别对照

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-client-ui-font-scale

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **client (browser) plugin**
that puts conversation font-size controls where you are already looking: a stepper in the composer
tool row, keyboard shortcuts, and `Ctrl`+wheel zoom.

No build step. The `lib/*.js` files are authored directly in the shipped bundle format, so cloning
the repository is enough.

## Why this exists

DSH already ships a conversation font-size setting — **Settings → General → 字号大小 / Font size**,
contributed by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`. Its copy is explicit that it *"only affects
conversation content"*, which is exactly the right scope.

This plugin does not replace or reimplement it. It adds the input surfaces that setting lacks:

- reaching it takes four clicks, so it is easy to forget it exists;
- there is no keyboard shortcut for it anywhere in the shipped shortcuts registry;
- there is no wheel gesture for it.

Every control here writes through the **same** `theme.setFontSize('text', px)` entry point the shipped
row uses, so the two can never disagree.

## What it does

| Surface | Where | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Stepper | composer tool row, before the submit action | `A−` / readout / `A+`, clamping at the ends |
| Reset | beside the stepper | `↺` restores the default; greys out when already there |
| Shortcuts | `Ctrl`+`=` / `Ctrl`+`-` / `Ctrl`+`0` | increase / decrease / restore default |
| Zoom | `Ctrl`+wheel over the page | wheel up enlarges, wheel down shrinks |

Both the readout and the reset button render the **live** size from the theme snapshot, so a change
made in the shipped settings row updates this control immediately, and vice versa.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (the `desktop` profile, or any profile mounting
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`).
- A theme service that exposes `setFontSize(role, px)` — i.e. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`,
  which ships in the default composition. **DSH 0.2.1 or newer**: that release split the single font
  size into the `text` / `code` / `terminal` roles, and this plugin drives `text`.
- No build step and no runtime dependencies beyond the browser module table.

## Install

This package is a **dsh bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so dsh treats
[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a composition layer and mounts it for you.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-client-ui-font-scale
```

That installs the package into the profile and appends it to the profile's bundle list. The profile
is watched, so dsh recomposes without a restart. Remove it with
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-client-ui-font-scale`.

### From a local checkout

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-client-ui-font-scale
```

### Mounting by hand

Compose [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) into the profile's own patch file, and make the
package resolvable from the profile directory:

```sh
pnpm add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-client-ui-font-scale --dir "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
```

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: font-scale
      name: dsh-client-ui-font-scale
```

A patch `insert` row may also name a path instead of a package — dsh rewrites `./`-relative and
absolute names to file URLs anchored at the patch file — which needs no install at all.

After installing, **reload the page**: a client plugin's bundle is wired into the index at render
time, so a page that was already open does not pick up a newly installed bundle.

## Persistence

This plugin stores nothing, deliberately.

`theme.setFontSize('text', px)` writes through the `ui-theme` settings scope on the Host
(`this.host.set('fontSize', px)`), and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`'s Host half re-embeds that
durable value into **every index render** as a boot script. The result:

- the size survives a page reload;
- the size survives an application restart;
- it is applied *before the shell mounts*, so there is no flash of the default size.

A second store here would be a second source of truth for one number. If you want to change how the
size persists, change it in `dsh-client-ui-theme`, not here.

## Range

The accepted range is **10–22 px in whole steps**, default **14**. That range belongs to the theme
service: `setFontSize` throws for a fractional or out-of-range value. Every control here clamps
rather than bypassing it, so the shipped settings row and this plugin always agree.

If you need to go beyond 22 px, note that `dsh-client-ui-layout` writes the size as an
*unimportant inline* `--dsh-content-font-size` on `<body>`, so a stylesheet rule with `!important`
can override it. Doing that from a plugin means owning the resulting split-brain with the shipped
setting, which is why this plugin does not.

## How it works

| Concern | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Seat | `ctx.slots.register` into `conversation.input.right` (a list slot, `replaceRisk: none`, empty in the default composition) |
| Read | `theme.getTheme().fontSizes.text`, re-rendered on the `theme/change` event |
| Write | `theme.setFontSize('text', px)` — the only font-size write entry |
| Keys | `ctx.shortcuts.register`, so bindings appear on the Shortcuts settings page and stay user-rebindable |
| Locale | `ctx.locale.register` + `ctx.locale.bind`; the readout and labels follow the active locale |
| Styles | one `<style>` element inserted in `ctx.effect`, removed on dispose |

### The font-size API changed in DSH 0.2.1

Before that release the theme service carried one `fontSize` and `setFontSize(px)` wrote it. Since
then the snapshot is `fontSizes: Record<'text' | 'code' | 'terminal', number>` and the write is
`setFontSize(role, px)`.

This plugin had been written against the old shape, and the mismatch failed in a way worth recording
because it produced no visible error surface:

- reading `.fontSize` returned `undefined`, so the readout fell back to the default and showed
  `14px` no matter what the real size was;
- `setFontSize(15)` passed `15` as the ROLE, so the service looked up `FONT_SIZE_SPECS[15]`, got
  `undefined`, and threw while formatting its own message — `spec.min` on an undefined spec. Every
  click, wheel step and shortcut died before writing anything.

The fix is the two lines in `lib/client.js` (`fontSizes?.[ROLE]` and `setFontSize(ROLE, next)`);
`ROLE` is `'text'`, whose 10..22 range and 14 default are unchanged.

Two ordering details are load-bearing:

- **Services are resolved per call** (`ctx.get('theme')`), not captured once in `apply`. A peer half
  may mount after this one, and a captured miss would silently disable a surface for the whole run.
- **Shortcuts and dictionaries register through `ctx.inject`**, which waits for the service instead
  of racing it. Registering against a not-yet-mounted service is a no-op, not an error, so the
  failure would be silent.

Shortcut bindings declare `regions: ['page', 'editable']`, so they keep working while the composer
has focus. On the desktop runtime no combination is reserved (`bindingIssue` returns early for
`desktop` on Windows and macOS), so `Ctrl`+`=` / `-` / `0` register cleanly.

## Development

```sh
node scripts/validate-plugin.mjs .
# or
npm run validate
```

The validator is read-only and asserts the contract this bundle depends on: the `dsh.client`
manifest, the `dsh.bundle.patch` layer, `apply()` on the host half, the `__ModuleLoader__.load`
wrapper with a factory id equal to the package name, `require('react')` beside `createElement`,
CSS template-literal integrity, and locale-dictionary symmetry. It reads dictionary keys out of the
object literals themselves, so labels reached through a variable still count.

Also worth running before a commit:

```sh
node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js
```

## Repository layout

```
lib/index.js                host half (empty apply: the bundle owns no host capability)
lib/client.js               browser half: slots, shortcuts, wheel, styles
cordis.patch.yml            the bundle's composition layer
scripts/validate-plugin.mjs structural validation
```

## Caveats

- The control is a decoration in the composer row, not a settings replacement. The shipped
  **Settings → General → Font size** row remains the canonical place to see and set the value.
- `Ctrl`+wheel calls `preventDefault`, which suppresses the Electron shell's own page zoom. That is
  intentional — the gesture should mean one thing — but it does mean `Ctrl`+wheel no longer zooms
  the whole page.
- The wheel handler is attached to `window`, so the gesture works anywhere over the page, not only
  over the conversation column.

      "path": "lib/client.js",
      "content": "/**
 * Client half of the font-scale bundle.
 *
 * The conversation font size is owned by the Client theme service; `setFontSize`
 * is its only write entry and only accepts integers inside the role's configured
 * range, so every path here clamps before writing. Four input surfaces drive one
 * shared step function, so they can never disagree about the current value:
 *
 *   - a stepper in the composer tool row (`conversation.input.right`)
 *   - a dedicated reset button, disabled while the size is already the default
 *   - keyboard shortcuts registered through the shortcuts service
 *   - Ctrl+wheel over the page
 *
 * The theme service speaks in font ROLES (`text`, `code`, `terminal`) since DSH
 * 0.2.1, so the snapshot is `fontSizes` and the write is `setFontSize(role, px)`.
 * This plugin drives `text` — the conversation content — and nothing else.
 *
 * Persistence is deliberately absent. `setFontSize` already writes through the
 * `ui-theme` settings scope, and the Host half re-embeds that durable value in
 * every index render, so the size survives a reload and an app restart. Storing
 * a second copy here would create two sources of truth for one number.
 *
 * Services are resolved lazily per use rather than captured once in `apply`:
 * a peer half may mount after this one, and a captured miss would silently
 * disable a surface for the rest of the run. Registration is the one case that
 * must wait, so shortcuts and dictionaries go through `ctx.inject`.
 */
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: 'dsh-client-ui-font-scale',
  factory(require) {
    const React = require('react')
    const h = React.createElement

    /**
     * Range and step mirrored from ui-theme's `FONT_SIZE_SPECS.text`
     * (min 10 / default 14 / max 22). The service throws outside this range, so
     * these are hard bounds, not preferences.
     */
    const MIN = 10
    const MAX = 22
    const DEFAULT = 14

    /** Trackpads emit dense wheel deltas; one step per cooldown keeps them sane. */
    const WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS = 60

    const NS = 'font-scale'

    const ZH = {
      increase: '增大字号',
      decrease: '减小字号',
      reset: '恢复默认字号',
      value: '当前字号',
    }
    const EN = {
      increase: 'Increase font size',
      decrease: 'Decrease font size',
      reset: 'Restore default font size',
      value: 'Current font size',
    }

    /**
     * Host tokens only, so the control belongs to the active theme in both
     * schemes. Fallbacks cover tokens a future theme may not define.
     */
    const CSS = `
.dshfs-root { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; }
.dshfs-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  height: 26px; min-width: 26px; padding: 0 5px;
  border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;
  font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1;
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary, var(--dsw-alias-label-primary));
  cursor: pointer;
}
.dshfs-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover);
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary);
}
.dshfs-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
/* The size readout is a passive indicator; the reset action has its own button. */
.dshfs-value {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  height: 26px; min-width: 34px; padding: 0 4px;
  font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary, var(--dsw-alias-label-primary));
}
.dshfs-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--dsw-focus-ring-color, var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary));
}
`

    /**
     * Clamp one requested size into the range the theme service accepts.
     * @param px - desired size, already integer or not.
     * @returns an integer inside MIN..MAX, or DEFAULT for unusable input.
     */
    function clamp(px) {
      const n = Math.round(Number(px))
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(MAX, Math.max(MIN, n)) : DEFAULT
    }

    /**
     * Client plugin body: provide the four input surfaces over one write path.
     * @param ctx - client cordis context.
     */
    function apply(ctx) {
      // Resolved per call: this package may load before ui-theme provides it.
      const themeOf = () => ctx.get('theme')

      /**
       * The role this plugin drives.
       *
       * DSH 0.2.1 split the single font size into independent roles (`text`, `code`,
       * `terminal`). The conversation content is `text`, and its spec — 10..22 with a
       * default of 14 — is the same range this file has always used, so only the API
       * shape changed, not the behaviour.
       */
      const ROLE = 'text'

      const current = () => themeOf()?.getTheme().fontSizes?.[ROLE] ?? DEFAULT
      const write = (px) => {
        const theme = themeOf()
        if (theme === undefined) return
        const next = clamp(px)
        if (next === current()) return
        // `setFontSize(role, px)`, not `setFontSize(px)`: a bare number is read as the
        // role, and the service then throws while formatting its own error message
        // (`spec.min` on an undefined spec), so every click died before writing.
        theme.setFontSize(ROLE, next)
      }
      const step = (delta) => write(current() + delta)

      // Visible copy goes through the locale service. Registered before the
      // first bind so the keys always resolve.
      let t = (key) => ZH[key] ?? key
      const localeOf = () => ctx.get('locale')
      const bindCopy = (scope) => {
        const locale = scope.locale ?? ctx.get('locale')
        if (locale === undefined) return
        scope.effect(() => locale.register(NS, { zh: ZH, en: EN }), `${NS}: dictionaries`)
        const bound = locale.bind(NS)
        t = (key) => bound(key)
      }
      if (typeof ctx.inject === 'function') ctx.inject(['locale'], bindCopy)
      else bindCopy(ctx)

      ctx.effect(() => {
        const el = document.createElement('style')
        el.textContent = CSS
        document.head.appendChild(el)
        return () => el.remove()
      }, `${NS}: styles`)

      // Ctrl+wheel. preventDefault suppresses the shell's own page zoom so the
      // gesture means one thing only.
      let lastWheel = 0
      ctx.effect(() => {
        const onWheel = (event) => {
          if (!event.ctrlKey || event.deltaY === 0) return
          event.preventDefault()
          const now = Date.now()
          if (now - lastWheel < WHEEL_COOLDOWN_MS) return
          lastWheel = now
          step(event.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1)
        }
        window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false })
        return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel)
      }, `${NS}: ctrl+wheel`)

      // Registered through the shortcuts service rather than a hand-rolled key
      // listener, so the bindings appear on the Shortcuts settings page and stay
      // user-rebindable. `inject` waits for the service instead of racing it.
      const commands = [
        { id: `${NS}.increase`, code: 'Equal', alias: 'increase conversation font size', label: () => t('increase'), run: () => step(1) },
        { id: `${NS}.decrease`, code: 'Minus', alias: 'decrease conversation font size', label: () => t('decrease'), run: () => step(-1) },
        { id: `${NS}.reset`, code: 'Digit0', alias: 'restore default conversation font size', label: () => t('reset'), run: () => write(DEFAULT) },
      ]
      const registerShortcuts = (scope) => {
        const shortcuts = scope.shortcuts ?? ctx.get('shortcuts')
        if (shortcuts === undefined) return
        for (const command of commands) {
          scope.effect(() => shortcuts.register({
            id: command.id,
            label: command.label,
            aliases: ['font size', command.alias],
            defaults: {
              'desktop:macos': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] },
              'desktop:windows': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] },
              'desktop:linux': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] },
              'web:macos': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] },
              'web:windows': { code: command.code, modifiers: ['primary'] },
            },
            // "editable" keeps the bindings alive while the composer has focus.
            regions: ['page', 'editable'],
            modals: [],
            resolve: () => ({ status: 'handled', run: command.run }),
          }), `${NS}: ${command.id}`)
        }
      }
      if (typeof ctx.inject === 'function') ctx.inject(['shortcuts'], registerShortcuts)
      else registerShortcuts(ctx)

      /** Composer-row stepper: read the snapshot, write through the service. */
      function Control() {
        const [, setTick] = React.useState(0)
        React.useEffect(() => {
          const bump = () => setTick((n) => n + 1)
